command: GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local timeout 90s go run ./.cache/refactor/scummvm-old-golden
mechanism: Old scummvm.New(...).Detect invokes the capture executable itself as a native fixture; actual parser/snapshot calls retained, no reimplementation.
isolation: Only generated public fixture bytes; input/run roots under a dedicated .cache/refactor/scummvm-old-golden/capture-* root; all removed after capture.
concurrency: At most parent and one native child; FIFO start barrier before manual cancellation/DeadlineExceeded; no sleep or business expiry wait.
normalizations: Generated sandbox paths replaced by <sandbox> in error text
Input root and run directory replaced by <input>/<run> in invocation; all other values/JSON bytes and hashes exact
rawInvalidUTF8: invalid-utf8-description source contains literal byte 0xff reconstructed by capture source; inputJSON representation in JSON output alone is not a lossless replay of that invalid UTF8 byte.
captureCorrection: Before production migration, corrected trailing-whitespace fixture from literal backslash n/t to actual newline/tab and re-ran all 53 old API cases.
